name: Finding Cinderella
source:
A lighthearted game about love and murder.

Assume the role of a royal successor to the throne, who is definitely not very good at their job or the brightest bulb there is, in their quest of finding the love of their life in the upcoming royal ball - select one of the 9 ladies to be your Cinderella.

But beware! There is an assassin coming for your life disguised as one of the ladies! Oh no! You must reveal the assassin's identity in 3 days time while winning the heart of your future queen. Get to know each lady, search for clues, but most importantly, survive!

[From [url=https://twohumanstudiowo.itch.io/finding-cinderella]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一款关于爱情与谋杀的轻松游戏。

你将扮演一位王位继承人，既不怎么称职，也算不上聪明绝顶。为了在即将到来的宫廷舞会上找到真爱，你要从九位女士中，选出属于自己的灰姑娘。

但要小心！一名刺客混在这些女士之中，正准备取你性命！糟糕！你必须在三天内揭穿刺客的身份，同时赢得未来王后的芳心。了解每位女士，搜寻线索，最重要的是，活下去！

[摘自[url=https://twohumanstudiowo.itch.io/finding-cinderella]Itch.io[/url]]
